project.name: analyze
project.description: Django-style library management app with loans, holds, fees and reports modules.

nodes.name: clock.py
nodes.summary: Provides the production clock that returns today's date in the configured Django timezone.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root that wires the loan application service with the Django repository and system clock into a shared singleton.

nodes.name: forms.py
nodes.summary: Django ModelForm validating member and isbn input for lending, rejecting blank values without stripping whitespace.

nodes.name: LoanForm
nodes.summary: ModelForm for Loan that requires non-blank member and isbn fields.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Loan Django model with a computed due date 14 days after lending.

nodes.name: Loan
nodes.summary: Loan model storing member, ISBN, lent and returned dates, with a due_on property of lent_on plus 14 days.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed repository for loans, supporting lookup, ID generation, creation, and transactional return marking.

nodes.name: DjangoLoanRepository
nodes.summary: Implements the LoanRepository protocol using the Loan model, with atomic create and row-locked mark_returned.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Framework-independent loan application logic with protocols for clock and repository, plus semicolon-delimited CSV loan formatting.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for structural typing of repository, clock and record dependencies.

nodes.name: LoanRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the fields of a loan record.

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.summary: Protocol for a clock providing today's date.

nodes.name: LoanRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol describing storage operations needed by the loan application.

nodes.name: ActiveLoan
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass naming the borrower of an active loan.

nodes.name: LoanApplication
nodes.summary: Application service for lending, returning, listing and querying loans via an injected repository and clock.

nodes.name: loan_line
nodes.summary: Serializes a loan to a semicolon-delimited CSV line with ISO dates.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routing mapping plain-text loan API paths and HTML UI paths to loan views.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views for loans: plain-text API endpoints for listing, lending, detail and return, plus HTMX-aware HTML pages.

nodes.name: loan_catalog
nodes.summary: Renders the HTML list of all loans.

nodes.name: loan_catalog_detail
nodes.summary: Renders the HTML detail page for a loan or returns 404.

nodes.name: loan_collection
nodes.summary: Handles GET to list loans as text and POST to lend.

nodes.name: loan_lend
nodes.summary: Validates the lend form and creates a loan, returning 201 text or 400 with errors.

nodes.name: loan_lend_page
nodes.summary: HTML lend page handling form display, HTMX partial responses and redirect on success.

nodes.name: loan_detail
nodes.summary: Returns a single loan as plain text or 404.

nodes.name: loan_return
nodes.summary: POST endpoint returning a loan, answering 404 or 409 when missing or already returned.

nodes.name: loan_return_page
nodes.summary: HTML return action supporting HTMX status fragments, 409 error page and redirect.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root that wires FeeApplication with the Django loan repository, system clock and HTTP payment gateway into a module-level singleton.

nodes.name: gateway.py
nodes.summary: HTTP payment gateway adapter that POSTs charges to a configurable URL without following redirects and maps network errors to PaymentGatewayFailure.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed repository that looks up Loan records by primary key for the fees domain.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Fee domain core: protocols for ports, immutable Fee and GatewayResponse value objects, and FeeApplication computing late fees and delegating payments.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routes for fee and payment JSON/text endpoints and the HTML UI pages.

nodes.name: view_helpers.py
nodes.summary: Helpers for views: formats cent amounts as dollars, maps payment results to body/status pairs, and returns a 404 response for unknown loans.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views for viewing late fees and paying them, in plain-HTML and template/HTMX variants, restricted to GET or POST.

nodes.name: HttpPaymentGateway
nodes.summary: Payment gateway implementation issuing a POST charge request and translating HTTP and network outcomes into GatewayResponse or PaymentGatewayFailure.

nodes.name: DjangoFeeLoanRepository
nodes.summary: Finds a Loan by primary key via the Django ORM, returning None when absent.

nodes.name: Fee
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding due date, days late and fee amount in cents.

nodes.name: GatewayResponse
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass carrying payment gateway HTTP status and body.

nodes.name: PaymentGatewayFailure
nodes.summary: Exception raised when the payment gateway is unreachable, carrying the response body.

nodes.name: FeeApplication
nodes.summary: Application service computing late fees (free for 2 days, 25 cents/day capped at 1000) and charging via the gateway for existing loans.

nodes.name: format_fee_amount
nodes.summary: Formats an amount in cents as a dollar string.

nodes.name: gateway_result
nodes.summary: Pays a loan fee and returns (body, status): 502 on failure, 404 for unknown loan, else 200 or 502.

nodes.name: fee_or_404
nodes.summary: Returns the computed Fee or an HTML 404 response when the loan does not exist.

nodes.name: fee_detail
nodes.summary: Renders a late-fee summary as inline HTML for a loan.

nodes.name: payment
nodes.summary: Handles POST payment for a loan, returning plain-text gateway result.

nodes.name: fee_page
nodes.summary: Renders the fee detail template for a loan.

nodes.name: payment_page
nodes.summary: Handles POST payment from the UI, returning an HTMX partial or the full detail page with payment status.

nodes.name: clock.py
nodes.summary: Provides a system clock returning the current local date, injected into the hold service for testable time.

nodes.name: SystemClock
nodes.summary: Clock implementation returning Django's timezone-aware local date.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root wiring the hold application with the Django repository, system clock, and the loan application.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Hold Django model with a computed 30-day expiry date.

nodes.name: Hold
nodes.summary: ORM model for a book hold with member, ISBN, placement and cancellation dates; expires 30 days after placement.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM persistence adapter for holds, including advisory-lock serialized placement and sequence-based identities.

nodes.name: DjangoHoldRepository
nodes.summary: Implements the HoldRepository port: queries active holds, counts per member, generates identities, creates and cancels holds under a Postgres advisory lock.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Domain layer for holds: ports as protocols, failure codes, and HoldApplication enforcing placement rules (required fields, book on loan, duplicates, limit) and cancellation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol ports for hexagonal-style dependency inversion.

nodes.name: HoldApplication
nodes.summary: Application service that places, lists and cancels holds, returning HoldFailure values for rule violations.

nodes.name: HoldRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol port describing persistence operations required by the hold service.

nodes.name: HoldRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the shape of a hold record.

nodes.name: LoanStateLookup
nodes.summary: Protocol port for querying the active loan of an ISBN.

nodes.name: hold_line
nodes.summary: Formats a hold as a semicolon-delimited text line.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routes for listing/placing holds and cancelling a hold by id.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views translating HTTP requests into hold service calls and mapping failures to plain-text status responses.

nodes.name: hold_collection
nodes.summary: Handles GET (list active holds) and POST (place hold) on the holds collection.

nodes.name: hold_cancel
nodes.summary: POST view cancelling a hold by id.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root that wires the Django repository and fee application into a shared MonthlyReportApplication instance.

nodes.name: monthly_report.py
nodes.summary: Django management command that prints the previous month lending report as CSV to stdout.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM adapter that fetches loans started within a date range for reporting.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Defines the monthly report application logic and protocol interfaces, aggregating per-member loans, late returns and late fees.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typing.Protocol for dependency inversion and frozen dataclasses for results.

nodes.name: MonthlyReportApplication
nodes.summary: Builds the previous-month report by counting loans, late returns and fees per member, sorted by fees descending.

nodes.name: for_previous_month
nodes.summary: Computes the previous calendar month window and aggregates per-member report rows.

nodes.name: MemberMonthlyReport
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding one member monthly totals.

nodes.name: MonthlyReportRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol for sources that return loans started in a date range.

nodes.name: FeeCalculator
nodes.summary: Protocol for computing a fee for a loan id.

nodes.name: DjangoMonthlyReportRepository
nodes.summary: Repository querying Loan objects whose lent_on falls in the half-open date range.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: Management command that writes the monthly report as CSV rows.

nodes.name: detail.html
nodes.summary: Late-fee detail page extending the base layout, showing due date, days late and amount, and including either the payment status or payment form partial.
nodes.languageNotes: Django template using htmx attributes for partial swaps.

nodes.name: payment-form.html
nodes.summary: htmx-enabled partial with a CSRF-protected form that posts the late-fee payment and swaps the result into #payment-status.
nodes.languageNotes: Django template using htmx attributes for partial swaps.

nodes.name: payment-status.html
nodes.summary: Partial rendering the payment outcome as a status or alert message inside the #payment-status container.
nodes.languageNotes: Django template using htmx attributes for partial swaps.

nodes.name: detail.html
nodes.summary: Loan detail page showing a single loan with an HTMX-enabled return form that posts to the return endpoint and swaps the return status.

nodes.name: list.html
nodes.summary: Loans list page extending the base layout and rendering all loans.

nodes.name: loan-created.html
nodes.summary: Small HTML fragment shown after a loan is successfully created.

nodes.name: loan-form.html
nodes.summary: Loan creation form fragment submitted via HTMX that replaces itself with the response.

nodes.name: new.html
nodes.summary: Page for lending a book that extends the base layout and includes the loan form fragment.

nodes.name: return-status.html
nodes.summary: Tiny fragment showing the result of returning a loan, swapped in by HTMX.

nodes.name: database_probe
nodes.summary: Executes SELECT 1 on the default Django connection and returns the integer result to verify the database is reachable.

nodes.summary: GET-only views serving the library's about information, once as a legacy rendered HTML response and once as a full template page.

nodes.name: about_page

nodes.summary: Initial Django migration creating the Loan model table and seeding three sample loans (one open, two returned).

nodes.name: base.html
nodes.summary: Base HTML layout for the Lending Library UI, loading DaisyUI, Tailwind and htmx, configuring htmx response handling, and providing header nav plus title and content blocks.
nodes.languageNotes: Django template with title and content blocks; htmx.config.responseHandling swaps 2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx responses except 204.

nodes.name: about.html
nodes.summary: About page extending base.html with the library tagline and a visitor information card covering hours, loan period and contact.

nodes.summary: Standalone minimal HTML about page with hours, loan period and contact, not using the base layout.
